name: Topology Simplification via Branch Decomposition
aliases: Improved Topological Simplification for Volume Rendering
definition: A hierarchical decomposition of a contour tree used to store a hierarchy of contour tree simplifications, avoiding oversegmentation by concatenating sequences of arcs into single units.
summary: Topology Simplification via Branch Decomposition efficiently stores contour tree simplifications hierarchically, avoiding oversegmentation by unifying topological zones without modifying the scalar field.
